content.text: Design signed off on a muted badge for retired codes on old records. Finishing the form filter next.

Admin UI for escalation severity still lists retired values Sev-0-legacy and experimental-p1 that the API no longer accepts on create. Saving a policy that includes them returns 422 and confuses workspace admins.

Remove retired values from the severity multiselect and from the default policy templates. Keep read-only display for historical escalations that still store those codes. Done when the admin form only offers active severities from GET /escalations/severities?status=active and a screenshot checklist is attached for docs.
